result.brief: 提出多智能体框架，从操作视频生成可编辑、可仿真的实验室设备资产（含关节机构与物理属性），并用于复现机器人实验室仿真场景。
result.reason: Agentic pipeline builds simulation-ready articulated assets from operation videos for robotic lab tasks; contributes to interactive simulation environments rather than video/world-model representation learning.
